name: mcp-data-unavailable
description: Drop all TCP connections to mcp-data for 30 seconds (simulates service restart or network partition). Tests Phase 1 mcp-data timeout wrappers in ai-agents and the retry/fallback path. ai-agents must return a structured error to clients rather than hanging or leaking INTERNAL.
note: mcp-data uses HTTP (not Mongo/Redis/RabbitMQ), so this profile must be applied directly via Docker stop rather than toxiproxy. See CHAOS_VERIFICATION.md runbook for the docker stop/start sequence.
